# pl_mpeg

PL_MPEG by Dominic Szablewski (https://github.com/phoboslab/pl_mpeg): an MPEG-1 video, MP2 audio
and MPEG-PS decoder in one header. MIT licence (in the header).

HIRAKU decodes Twinkle's Video CDs with it (`runtime/twinkle/video.cpp`, PLAN.md section 21,
TW-3): beatmania IIDX's background videos, which MAME doesn't show.

- **Source:** the copy in windyfairy's MAME fork (https://github.com/987123879113/mame, branch
  `bemani_k573msu_wip` at `928dfcb`, `3rdparty/pl_mpeg/pl_mpeg.h`), unchanged.
  MD5 63f4037b47aa314011a96c757801be74.
